subtitle: Lesson 18 · Linux System Hardening Engineering

code:
sysctl -a | less

sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 0

sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=0   # lost at reboot
caption: A sysctl -w change is real but temporary — it disappears on the next boot.
Four settings worth hardening by name: forwarding, core dumps, SYN floods, pointer exposure.
